question: Indicate which of the following is a mitochondrial disease:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "α-thalassemia" -> "hemoglobin production issue" -> "red blood cell disorder" -> "not mitochondrial disease" -> 80%
CHAIN: "Essential fructosuria" -> "fructose metabolism issue" -> "liver enzyme deficiency" -> "not mitochondrial disease" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Cushing's syndrome" -> "excess cortisol" -> "endocrine disorder" -> "not mitochondrial disease" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Sickle cell anemia" -> "abnormal hemoglobin" -> "red blood cell deformation" -> "not mitochondrial disease" -> 95%
analysis: Leigh syndrome is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that is classified as a mitochondrial disease. It is caused by mutations affecting mitochondrial function, leading to energy production issues in cells. The other options listed are not mitochondrial diseases: α-thalassemia and sickle cell anemia are genetic blood disorders, essential fructosuria is a benign metabolic disorder, and Cushing's syndrome is an endocrine disorder.
